visual_authority.reference_role: style grammar only; no depicted object, silhouette, icon, card shell, or layout approved or copied

common_constraints: three to five broad filled planes
hard antialiased edges and dark separation
no text, numbers, card frame, UI chrome, background scene, tiny greebles, repeated lamps, nested outlines, or decorative seams
must remain readable at 72, 88, and 104 pixels and in grayscale
